title: Discount Coupons Changes Name of The Company to Ecom Products Group
主要内容: Discount Coupons Corporation announced a name change to Ecom Products Group, reflecting a shift from a daily deal business to a product offering company. The change was approved by Florida and the company is updating regulatory agencies and applying for a new ticker symbol. The company has shifted its core focus to product distribution relationships that align with customers. It operates in two segments: daily deal site management and full-service digital marketing agency services. Daily deal websites sell discounted vouchers to consumers, typically at 50% off retail pricing, which are redeemed at websites or local businesses. Businesses benefit from a Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) marketing model where they pay a set fee per voucher sold.
